column4: dialect-gated: cleat#2234's MySQL-idempotency test for migrations.go v3 (backup_history_config_id_fkey's ADD CONSTRAINT guard) is MySQL-only by nature -- it exercises a re-run of MySQL's PREPARE/EXECUTE/DEALLOCATE guard specifically, which PostgreSQL and SQL Server do not need (their arms are IF NOT EXISTS / sys.foreign_keys guarded directly). It checks os.Getenv("CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL") and calls t.Skip explicitly (not the loop-over-testutil.NewPluginTestBackends-with-continue shape, which silently no-ops with zero skip events instead -- the same trap cleat-review flagged as a nit on cleat#2242's ingest-race test), so it skips once, at the top level, in ci.yml's test-go/plugins job (PostgreSQL only via CLEAT_TEST_DB) and runs wherever CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL is set. Measured by name: go test ./plugins/scheduledbackup/... -run TestBackupHistoryConfigIdCascadeMigrationIsIdempotentOnMySQL -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL unset reports exactly this one skip.
